questions.qa: The number of students taking both French and Spanish

questions.stem: In a jar, the ratio of red marbles to blue marbles is 5 to 3. After 10 red marbles are removed, the ratio of red marbles to blue marbles is 5 to 4. How many marbles were in the jar originally?

questions.expl: Verilen doğrunun eğimi −2/3; dik doğrunun eğimi 3/2. y − 2 = (3/2)(x − 1) → x = 0'da y = 2 − 1,5 = 0,5.
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ passes through the point (1, 2) and is perpendicular to the line 2x + 3y = 6. What is the y-intercept of line ℓ?

questions.stem: A driver travels 60 kilometers at an average speed of 30 kilometers per hour and then travels another 60 kilometers at an average speed of 60 kilometers per hour. What is the driver's average speed, in kilometers per hour, for the entire 120 kilometers?

questions.expl: 6'yı taban al. Yükseklik en fazla 8 (aradaki açı 90° iken). Alan 0 ile 24 arasında her değeri alabilir (24 dahil). 4, 12, 20, 24 ✓; 25 ve 48 ✗.

Two sides of a triangle have lengths 6 and 8. Which of the following could be the area of the triangle?
Indicate all such values.

If 3x = 81 and 2x + y = 128, what is the value of y?

questions.short: Nis→May ve May→Haz'da mutlak artış aynı (18); tabanı küçük olan (90) yüzde olarak daha büyük.
questions.stem: For which of the following pairs of consecutive months was the percent change in the number of subscribers greatest in absolute value?
What was the average (arithmetic mean) number of subscribers, in thousands, at the end of the six months shown?
